verdict.rationale: Databricks hosts a first-party docs page explaining what dbt is, how to install dbt Core, and how to connect it to Databricks. Developers can write dbt code in their own IDE and run it from the command line against the platform, which meets the 'documented adapter with vendor docs' bar. Missing for 10: explicit naming or details of the adapter package, evidence of native in-workspace dbt project or job-task support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
